messages:
Asha Patel: Hi team — Crescent Health just sent over their vendor security questionnaire + DPA. Primary asks: SOC2 status, KMS, data residency, and deletion policy. Attaching form: https://files.redwood/review/CR-473.pdf
Luca Moreno: Thanks — I uploaded the PDF to the CS drive. Do we have canned answers for the 'data subject rights' section? They want deletion within 30 days.
Samir Khan: SOC2 Type II (2024-06) — cert available here: https://redwood.internal/certs/soc2-2024.pdf. Data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed KMS for Private customers; hosted uses our KMS (GCP KMS/HSM). We can commit to deletion requests within 30 days for dedicated/private; hosted is 45 days due to backups. (cc @Maya Chen)
Maya Chen: Legal: DPA signature fine. For the 30-day deletion, we should propose '30 business days' for enterprise; include exceptions for backups and logs — sample clause below:
```
We will delete Customer Data upon written request within thirty (30) business days, subject to necessary retention for backups, legal holds, or fraud prevention.
```
Samir Khan: For the vendor form Q12 (data residency) — we host in us-east1 and europe-west1 for this account. If they require dedicated region, we can offer Private in eu-west with dedicated capacity.
Asha Patel: Great. Can someone draft responses to the vendor PDF by EOD? I'll send to customer for review tomorrow.
Luca Moreno: I can draft the responses. Will ping @Samir for KMS wording and @Maya for legal clauses.
security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 cert expires 2026-06-15 — initiate renewal plan at least 90 days before expiry. (automated)
Maya Chen: Also: include contact info for incident response: security@redwood.com and a dedicated account escalation path.
Samir Khan: Q on encryption-in-transit: we use TLS1.2+ and support mTLS for Private customers. Add that line.
Asha Patel: Perfect — timeline: Luca drafts by 17:00 PT, Samir and Maya review by 19:00 PT, I deliver to Crescent tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Luca Moreno: On it — will post the draft in this thread when ready.
